source.userFeedback: 原版台面有厚度并落在地面上，物体一层层接触摆放；当前台面和物体仍像悬空。

rootCauseHypothesis: The current visible support meshes are treated as thin floating slabs instead of thick grounded bases.
Tabletop top heights and item resting heights are not authored as one contact chain.
The renderer does not consistently show a base-to-ground contact shadow for the first-level platforms.
acceptance: Every visible Level 1 tabletop has a thick base whose bottom meets the runway/ground plane.
Every intact tabletop item has a visible contact relationship with its support or another item in its stack.
At least one stack uses intentional horizontal overlap without any unsupported gap.
Natural desktop and 390x844 portrait captures show no unexplained floating tabletop or stack.
